nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a, b, c$ and $q > 0$, $\lfloor a/q \rfloor + \lfloor b/q \rfloor + \lfloor c/q \rfloor \le \lfloor (a+b+c)/q \rfloor$.
nodes.title: Superadditivity of floor division for three terms

nodes.summary: Let $e$ be Euler's number, let $a$ and $c$ be real numbers and let $m, n$ be nonzero natural numbers, with $a \ge 0$, $e^{m/n} \ge 0$ and $c > e$. If $c^m < a^n$, then $e^{m/n} < a$.
nodes.title: Power comparison above e bounds an exponential

nodes.summary: For real numbers $a > 0$ and $r$, if $e^r < a$ then $r < \log a$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
nodes.title: Logarithm lower bound from an exponential bound

nodes.summary: Let $a$ and $r$ be real numbers with $a > 0$. If $a < e^r$, then $\log a < r$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
nodes.title: Bounding a logarithm above by the exponential

nodes.summary: The natural logarithm of $2$ satisfies $0.6931 < \log 2$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for log 2

nodes.summary: The natural logarithm of $3$ satisfies $\log 3 < 1.0987$.
nodes.title: Upper bound for log 3

nodes.summary: The natural logarithm of $5$ satisfies $1.6094 < \log 5$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for log 5

nodes.summary: Let $a$ and $c$ be nonnegative real numbers and let $n$ and $m$ be positive integers. If $c < e$ and $a^n < c^m$, then $a < e^{m/n}$, where $m/n$ is real division.
nodes.title: Exponential lower bound from a power comparison

nodes.summary: Let $M(t) = \frac{(6t)!}{(3t)!\,(2t)!\,t!}$. For every natural number $t \ge 23$, $10^{5t-5} \cdot M(t) \le 34^{5t-5}$, that is, $M(t) \le 3.4^{5t-5}$.
nodes.title: Power bound for the multinomial coefficient $M(t)$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ let $n\#$ be the primorial, the product of the primes $p \le n$, and let $M(t) = \frac{(6t)!}{(3t)!\,(2t)!\,t!}$. For every natural number $m \ge 1$, with $t = \lfloor (m+5)/6 \rfloor$, we have $m\# \le t\# \cdot M(t)$.
nodes.title: Splitting the primorial with a multinomial coefficient

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ let $n\#$ be the primorial, the product of the primes $p \le n$. For every natural number $m < 133$, $10^m \cdot m\# \le 34^m$.
nodes.title: Primorial bound $3.4^m$ below $133$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the primorial $m\#$ (the product of all primes $p \le m$) satisfies $10^m \cdot m\# \le 34^m$.
nodes.title: Primorial bound by powers of 3.4, integer form

nodes.summary: For every real number $x \ge 0$, the primorial of $\lfloor x \rfloor$ (the product of all primes $p \le \lfloor x \rfloor$) is at most $3.4^x$, where $3.4^x$ is the real power.
nodes.title: Primorial bound by powers of 3.4, real form

nodes.summary: For every natural number $t \ge 1$ and every prime $p$ with $t < p \le 6t$, the exponent of $p$ in the prime factorization of the multinomial coefficient $M(t) = (6t)!/((3t)!\,(2t)!\,t!)$ is at least $1$.
nodes.title: Primes in $(t, 6t)$ occur in $M(t)$

nodes.summary: Let $t \ge 1$ and $p$ be natural numbers with $3t < p \le 6t$. Then $\lfloor 6t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 3t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 2t/p \rfloor \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Floor-difference bound on the range 3t < p ≤ 6t

nodes.summary: Let $t \ge 1$ and $p$ be natural numbers with $2t < p \le 3t$. Then $\lfloor 6t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 3t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 2t/p \rfloor \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Floor-difference bound on the range 2t < p ≤ 3t

nodes.summary: Let $t \ge 1$ and $p$ be natural numbers with $3t < 2p$ and $p \le 2t$. Then $\lfloor 6t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 3t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 2t/p \rfloor \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Floor-difference bound on the range 3t/2 < p ≤ 2t

nodes.summary: Let $t \ge 1$ and $p$ be natural numbers with $6t < 5p$ and $2p \le 3t$. Then $\lfloor 6t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 3t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 2t/p \rfloor \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Floor-difference bound on the range 6t/5 < p ≤ 3t/2

nodes.summary: Let $t \ge 1$ and $p$ be natural numbers with $t < p$ and $5p \le 6t$. Then $\lfloor 6t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 3t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 2t/p \rfloor \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Floor-difference bound on the range t < p ≤ 6t/5

nodes.summary: Let $t \ge 1$ and $p$ be natural numbers with $t < p \le 6t$. Then $\lfloor 6t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 3t/p \rfloor - \lfloor 2t/p \rfloor \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Floor-difference bound on the range t < p ≤ 6t
